messages:
Morgan: Hey folks — PR #9421 is ready for merge but the Vercel preview failed. Error looks like a missing/forbidden GIF sprite at /static/assets/emoji-sprite.gif. Local build is green. Can someone do a quick eyeball before the midnight merge window?

CI-bot: Vercel preview failed for branch docs/emoji-sprite — 1 error: GET /static/assets/emoji-sprite.gif -> 403. Preview URL: https://vercel.com/preview/9421 

Alex: I'll take a look. Quick Q — did you add the file to the mkdocs source dir and reference the same path in markdown? We had mismatched paths last time.

Morgan: I added it at docs/assets/emoji-sprite.gif and linked it as `![](assets/emoji-sprite.gif)`. `mkdocs build` locally shows it at /assets/emoji-sprite.gif, but Vercel preview rewrites to /static/assets/... which is giving the 403.

Sam: FYI Vercel can block large static files unless configured — also caching rules sometimes cause 403s for newly uploaded blobs. How big is the GIF?

Morgan: It's ~1.2MB. Thinking we should optimize it down or push to a CDN. Optimizing would be faster for this PR.

Alex: For a fast local sanity check you can do: `pipx run mkdocs serve` then open http://127.0.0.1:8000 and hit the page, or `mkdocs build && python -m http.server -d site 8000` to mirror static serving. That usually reproduces the path layout.

Sam: If you want to optimize: `gifsicle -O3 --colors 128 -o docs/assets/emoji-sprite.min.gif docs/assets/emoji-sprite.gif` then swap the reference. That trimmed a similar sprite from 1.8MB -> 260KB for us.

Morgan: Thanks — I'll try gifsicle now and push a smaller asset. Also @Sam — would you be able to be the reviewer once I push? Planning to merge during the quiet window tonight if CI passes.

Sam: Yup, can review after your force-push. Ping me on the PR when it's up.

CI-bot: Rebuild requested by Morgan — queued to re-run preview.

Alex: One more follow-up idea: for permanent fix we should add a short note to the docs CONTRIBUTING.md about asset size limits and a sample `static_assets` entry in our build config so Vercel doesn't rewrite those paths. I can open a tiny follow-up PR after this.

Morgan: Pushed optimized sprite and updated the markdown to `emoji-sprite.min.gif`. Re-requesting review. Thanks all.
